description: Isolate the old leader's sole unchosen entry, form a new quorum on the other two nodes, decide a different value, then heal through documented reconnect callbacks and genuine Prepare/AcceptSync before the next origin actor notification tick. Observe the exact original future and decided entry content after completion.

harness.description: Public API integration test; raw core setup followed by one actor owner and two synchronous core peers. All protocol messages are emitted by target code. TRACE lines retain packet provenance and ordered routing; CA_EVENT lines retain admission and result.
semantic_changes: No target behavior modifications. Test transport partitions node 1 and later heals; time configuration uses 10-second ticks and 1ms egress to allow legal incoming processing between notifier ticks.
Test AsyncRuntime delegates spawning and sleep to tokio; keeps actor join handle for observed shutdown. Core peers are synchronously driven and their clocks/transport serviced during result wait.

legality.derivation: Initial synchronous cluster is prepared by try_become_leader and complete authentic-message delivery. Same node-1 instance is moved into spawn_actor with no reconstruction or state editing. Its A acceptance messages are dropped during partition, so only node 1 has A. Node 2 manually attempts leadership through the public API, obtains node-3 promise and acceptance, and decides B at the vacant first position. On healing, reconnected callbacks generate genuine recovery traffic; streams are drained in emission order without fabricated or duplicate messages. Within each directed link, remaining packets preserve order; old packets dropped by partition are never replayed. Actor read commands confirm installation of B before notifier evaluation. Actor has one mutable owner; result is joined and read before handles drop, then actor shutdown is awaited.
legality.applicability: One captured crate with original manifests/dependencies; no injected protocol internals, altered sources, crashes, snapshots or batching. Real timers need only allow this finite legal interleaving; no protocol numeric deadline is inferred.
alternatives: A tick observing the new ballot before decision would return Superseded. This check intentionally permits incoming Prepare and AcceptSync between ticks, as the actor loop does.

grounding.derivation: admitted is emitted after authentic AcceptDecide messages demonstrate acceptance of the only notify call, while its future remains pending and local decided index is zero. The result joins that exact future and then reads actor-owned decided contents through the read command. Operation/scenario identity is independent of compared content and changing ballot. actual_value is read at returned_index-1; -1 denotes no such entry and differs from the positive input domain.
grounding.applicability: Single unbatched, uncompacted operation with real message history and no concurrent application proposals after replacement.
alternatives: An error is completed but does not assert that the submitted value was decided.

observable_properties.description: For the admitted call, observed successful completion implies that the decided entry at its returned assigned position equals the submitted value. Errors satisfy only this implication; missing results remain unknown.

uncertainties: No universal consensus-safety conclusion, crash guarantee or deadline proof.
The construction exploration saw a discrepancy but does not supply this fixed check's Evidence.
